newsitem.title: USA: Video Lottery settles with EDS.
newsitem.headline: Video Lottery settles with EDS.

text.p: Video Lottery Technologies Inc said Tuesday it settled a dispute with EDS Corp, and expects to recognize a pretax gain more than $20 million in the first quarter of 1997.
But the company added that it also expects significant write-offs and asset adjustments in the fourth quarter of 1996 related to its AWI subsidiary.

Under the settlement agreement, VLT received EDS's 2,458,182 shares of VLT stock and about $7 million of equipment from EDS in return for a $27 million note payable to EDS over seven years. VLT said it also expects to hire 400 to 450 current EDS employees to service certain customers.
At the same time, VLT said it has revised its relationship with First Bank System Inc and extended the current credit facility through February, 1998.
The company said that the settlement significantly strengthens its balance sheet and reduces costs.
